title: Megane-Bashi (Spectacles Bridge) | See & Do | DISCOVER NAGASAKI/The Official Visitors' Guide

facts.fact: Megane Bridge spans the Nakajima River and dates to1634; its name refers to the spectacle-like reflection of its arches.
facts.excerpt: In 1634, Japan's first Chinese-style stone bridge, the Spectacle Bridge, was constructed

facts.fact: The spectacles effect depends on the reflected arches on the river surface; it is a bridge in the urban river corridor.
facts.excerpt: when the arches of the bridges are reflected as ovals on the surface of the river.
